question.text: For a Cat III AIF structured as a trust treating its income as 'Profits or Gains from Business or Profession', the tax is paid by:

explanation.text: The Logic: Business or profession income of a Cat III AIF organised as a trust is taxed at the fund level at the Maximum Marginal Rate (MMR). A Cat III AIF set up as a company or LLP is taxed at the rates applicable to that entity instead. The Trap: Unit-holder or trustee-level taxation on business income is not how Cat III operates; the entity-level taxation depends on the legal form of the fund. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XIX-B AIF (Cat III) Distributors workbook, pp.298-300 and 304.
